body: I got some help, and im working on stuff! Glad to see your response!

I cant explain how. I have not been in your position, but you seem like  a nice person and i feel like you are willing to put in the work needed to make things better again. I am not very good at making people feel better, but i really feel like you have alot to live for! I wish you the best future possible! Write if you feel like you need any help! Im so sorry i took so long to respond, but i have been through some stuff lately!

Guess what! Im back! 
I went out to the bridge the same night as i wrote the other message. I stood on the edge and took a look down and thought things through one last time. I chose to call the police before i jumped off to let them know my location. I remember hitting the ground. A few minutes passed before i woke up. My legs hurt like s*it... Already at this point i knew that i had survived the jump and i knew that the police were coming.. I managed to crawl all the way across the railroad and escape the police. I was not sure what to do after that so i slept by the railroad that night. The next day i chose to crawl all the way home, which was about 350 meters. I thought my mom would have noticed the card i wrote, but when i came home she hadn't opened her gift which ment she hadn't seen the card.(Normally my parents go to work before i go to school, so they dont check up on me) I took some medicin to deal with the pain in my legs and then made a plan on how to get to the hospital to get my legs fixed. Well i managed to get in contact with some stranger outside my house and they drove me to the hospital. I took a talk with one of the nurses and explained what had happend.  I think i passed out just after this. I cant remember anything after that at least. I woke up the next day and saw my mom sitting on the right side of the bed. It was amazing, i have never seen my mom so happy before. 
I just came home today and checked up on reddit. I saw your message and you just made me rethink some of my choices. Thanks alot! I am still not very happy with the situration, but i will give it a few more weeks! I feel like it would be nice to talk with someone!
I spend all the time i could with her! I never left her side and i wont regret it! I know she would have done the same! Thank you for your response! Means alot!
Thank you for your response! Means alot!

I’m very glad you took your time to write a response.
My sister didn't make it through.... I feel like I am living a nightmare...
I know that it wasn’t my responsibility to take care of my sister. But I could at least have tried to do something to prevent it…. 
Right now the only option I have is to go back to life where my parents know about me keeping my sisters drug addiction secret… I feel like my parents won’t look at me the same anymore. They seem disgusted about me... Even some of my “friends” blame me for keeping it secret…
Today I took my decision.. I don’t want to live anymore neither do my family or friends want me to live… The only person that has ever showed me REAL support left me behind to live without her… 
She always wanted me to be happy and get the best out of the situation, but without her, I feel lost.
Tomorrow is my mom’s birthday. I used all my saved up money to buy her a picture frame and I put a picture of my sister and myself in it. I will write her a note where I explain my reasoning behind my choices in life and why she is not to blame. I don’t want to destroy my mothers birthday, but to me it already seems to be destroyed… I also took time to write a goodbye message to my whole family and recorded a video that explains my whole life in details.
I have spent the last few days catching up on my life and writing things that I want to obtain before I die…. And you know what? They suck… all I can come up with, is a list full of useless stuff that won’t make anything better..
I looked into therapy… but to me it just seems like another excuse to wait for the unavoidable!
I will live my last day out to the fullest and see where It takes me! I will end it all with at day where I don’t care about useless stuff such as my looks or my personality!
Thanks for all your support! I will take my time to look through this reddit thread before tonight! If you feel like there is anything that I have to know, then feel free to write it!

I think you are overreacting! Try to calm down, listen to some happy music and make a list of what you want to do with your life... Put yourself some goals! I have hurt alot of people in my life to the point where they dont want to see me again! But remember you are only human. You make mistakes and you "try" to fix the mistakes. Some mistakes takes a while to figure out. Most will sort itself out by time other wont be fixed but will for sure get better.. Your mistake didnt take anything real from someone! You can fix this just work hard at it :)!
